name: Launch token with cross-chain metadata
description: ISSUE a token on chain A, store its metadata as a FILE action on chain B (cheaper / cleaner medium), then LINK the two so explorers thread the metadata to the issuance.

params.DESCRIPTION: MYTOKEN - see metadata FILE action on the secondary chain

actions.note: Pick the chain you want the canonical issuance on (e.g. Bitcoin).
Upload the metadata JSON on a cheaper chain (e.g. Dogecoin or Litecoin) - DATA is hex / utf8 per the FILE format.
Fill the COIN1/COIN2 tickers and action indices after rows 1 + 2 confirm. The LINK threads them in History (§23.5).
